functions.name: PROFILE_DOMAIN
functions.natspec: @notice Domain separator label for v1 split profile identifiers.

functions.name: SCHEMA_VERSION
functions.natspec: @notice Split profile schema version used in profile identifiers and events.

functions.name: WALLET_VERSION
functions.natspec: @notice Split wallet implementation version used in profile identifiers and events.

functions.name: MAX_ENTRIES
functions.natspec: @notice Maximum canonical split entries accepted by one profile.

functions.name: MAX_UNIQUE_ACCOUNTS
functions.natspec: @notice Maximum unique recipient accounts accepted by one profile.

functions.name: SHARE_DENOMINATOR_PPM
functions.natspec: @notice Parts-per-million denominator for split shares.

functions.name: assetPolicyRegistry
functions.natspec: @notice Deployment-wide registry for approved standard ERC-20 split assets.

functions.name: splitWalletInitCodeHash
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the creation-code hash used for deterministic wallet addresses.

functions.name: splitWalletRuntimeCodeHash
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the runtime-code hash accepted for deployed split wallets.

functions.name: createProfile
functions.natspec: @notice Creates or reuses a canonical split profile and deploys its deterministic wallet.

functions.name: deployWallet
functions.natspec: @notice Deploys the deterministic wallet for an existing profile if it is not deployed.

functions.name: profileExists
functions.natspec: @notice Returns whether a split profile has been created by this factory.

functions.name: splitWalletExists
functions.natspec: @notice Returns true when the profile wallet is deployed with expected code and metadata.

functions.name: profileMetadataURIHash
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the immutable metadata URI hash committed by a split profile.

functions.name: profileEntriesHash
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the canonical entry hash committed by a split profile.

functions.name: walletFor
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the CREATE2 wallet address for a profile whether or not it is deployed.

functions.name: profileIdFor
functions.natspec: @notice Computes the profile identifier for entries after canonical sorting.

functions.name: profileEntryCount
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the number of canonical entries stored for a profile.

functions.name: profileEntry
functions.natspec: @notice Returns one canonical profile entry by sorted index.

functions.name: profileUniqueAccountCount
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the number of unique accounts after label-level shares are aggregated.

functions.name: profileUniqueAccount
functions.natspec: @notice Returns one unique account and its aggregate share by sorted account index.
